topic: Haggling Politely at a Neighborhood Garage Sale

script.title: AT THE GARAGE SALE
script.scene_zh: 住家車庫 · 收攤議價
script.story_hook: It's the last hour of a neighborhood sale.
script.intro_zh: 這是社區特賣會的最後一個鐘頭。
script.welcome_en: Hi, come browse a Sunday garage sale. Listen for friendly haggling lines.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，一起來逛逛週日的車庫特賣。留意友善殺價的說法。
script.outro: And that's a sale closed with a smile. Listen again and haggle along.
script.outro_zh: 一筆特賣就這樣開心成交了。再聽一次，跟著一起殺價看看。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a tall young man in his late teens with shaggy dirty-blonde hair under a backwards navy cap, a faded red band t-shirt, denim shorts, scuffed white sneakers, and a lanky skinny build
script.char_b_description: a kind elderly woman in her seventies with short curly snow-white hair, reading glasses on a beaded chain, a floral purple cotton house dress, a wide straw sun hat, and a small rounded build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, are you still selling, or closing up?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ɑr ju stɪl ˈsɛlɪŋ ɔɹ ˈkloʊzɪŋ ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，你還在賣嗎，還是準備收了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Closing soon, but take a look if you like.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkloʊzɪŋ sun bʌt teɪk ə lʊk ɪf ju laɪk/
dialogue.zh: 馬上就要收了，不過你喜歡就先看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I love this little wooden side table.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ lʌv ðɪs ˈlɪɾəl ˈwʊdən saɪd ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 我好喜歡這張小木邊桌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, that one's been my favorite for years.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðʌt wʌnz bɪn maɪ ˈfeɪvɚət fɚ jɪɹz/
dialogue.zh: 噢，那張是我這些年最心愛的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's perfect for my tiny apartment, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈpɝfɪkt fɚ maɪ ˈtaɪni əˈpɑɹtmənt ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，它超適合我的小套房。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, what are you thinking it's worth?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl wʌt ɑr ju ˈθɪŋkɪŋ ɪts wɝθ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，那你覺得它值多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, would you take fifteen for it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm wʊd ju teɪk fɪfˈtin fɚ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，十五塊賣不賣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifteen? It was my grandmother's, you know.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪfˈtin ɪt wəz maɪ ˈɡɹænmɑðɚz ju noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 十五？這是我祖母留下的耶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I get that, sorry, twenty if that helps?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ɡɛt ðæt ˈsɑɹi ˈtwɛnti ɪf ðæt hɛlps/
dialogue.zh: 我懂，抱歉，那二十呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, I'd hate to just give it away.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm aɪd heɪt tə dʒʌst ɡɪv ɪt əˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我也不想隨便就送人了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Of course, I don't want to lowball you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔɹs aɪ doʊnt wɑnt tə ˈloʊbɔl ju/
dialogue.zh: 當然，我也不想故意壓你的價。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, that's kind of you to say.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks ðæts kaɪnd əv ju tə seɪ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，你這樣說我很開心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, could we land somewhere near twenty-five?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ kʊd wi lænd ˈsomwɛɹ nɪɹ ˈtwɛnti faɪv/
dialogue.zh: 那我們能不能談到二十五左右？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty-five... you drive a hard bargain, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti faɪv ju dɹaɪ ə hɑɹd ˈbɑɹɡən hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 二十五……你真會殺價，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only 'cause it's so lovely, truly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli kəz ɪts soʊ ˈlʌvli ˈtɹuli/
dialogue.zh: 是因為它真的太美啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine, twenty-five it is for the table.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn ˈtwɛnti faɪv ɪt ɪz fɚ ðə ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 好啦，邊桌就二十五成交。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yay, thank you! Can I grab this lamp too?
dialogue.phonetic: /jeɪ θæŋk ju kən aɪ ɡɹæb ðɪs læmp tu/
dialogue.zh: 太好了！這盞燈我可以一起拿嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The brass one? That's ten on its own.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɹæs wʌn ðæts tɛn ɑn ɪts oʊn/
dialogue.zh: 黃銅那個？它單賣要十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten? Hmm, the shade looks a bit cracked.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn həm ðə ʃeɪd lʊks ə bɪt kɹækt/
dialogue.zh: 十塊？嗯，燈罩有點裂開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, but the bulb still works fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz bʌt ðə bʌlb stɪl wɝks faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 是有點裂，但燈泡都能正常用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you do six if I take both?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ju du sɪks ɪf aɪ teɪk boʊθ/
dialogue.zh: 兩樣一起買，燈六塊可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both for... let me think, thirty total?
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ fɔɹ lɛt mi θɪŋk ˈθɝɾi ˈtoʊɾəl/
dialogue.zh: 兩樣……我想想，一共三十？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thirty's fair, honestly. Do you take cash only?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɝɾiz fɛɹ ˈɑnəstli du ju teɪk kæʃ ˈoʊnli/
dialogue.zh: 三十很公道。你只收現金嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cash only, sorry, my card thing died.
dialogue.phonetic: /kæʃ ˈoʊnli ˈsɑɹi maɪ kɑɹd θɪŋ daɪd/
dialogue.zh: 只收現金，抱歉，我的刷卡機壞了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No worries. I've got... um, exact?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwɝiz aɪv ɡɑt ʌm ɪɡˈzækt/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。我帶的……嗯，錢會剛好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check, thirty with the little lamp.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi tʃɛk ˈθɝɾi wɪð ðə ˈlɪɾəl læmp/
dialogue.zh: 我算算，加小燈一共三十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shoot, I only have a fifty on me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊt aɪ ˈoʊnli hæv ə ˈfɪfti ɑn mi/
dialogue.zh: 糟了，我身上只帶了一張五十的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, I can run inside and get change.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ aɪ kən ɹʌn ɪnˈsaɪd ænd ɡɛt tʃeɪndʒ/
dialogue.zh: 噢，我可以進屋去換零錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only if it's not a hassle for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ɪf ɪts nɑt ə ˈhæsəl fɚ ju/
dialogue.zh: 這樣不會太麻煩你嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: None at all, I'll be one quick sec.
dialogue.phonetic: /nʌn æt ɔl aɪl bi wʌn kwɪk sɛk/
dialogue.zh: 完全不麻煩，我一下就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, and can I ask what's in this box?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ænd kən aɪ æsk wʌts ɪn ðɪs bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 好，這箱裡裝的是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old magazines and some paperbacks, all junk.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊd ˈmæɡəˌzɪnz ænd sʌm ˈpeɪɚˌbæks ɔl dʒʌŋk/
dialogue.zh: 舊雜誌和一些平裝書，都是廢品。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Junk? These cookbooks look kind of great.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌŋk ðiz ˈkʊkˌbʊks lʊk kaɪnd əv ɡɹeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 廢品？這些食譜看起來挺棒的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Really? I can toss them in the lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹili aɪ kən tɔs ðɛm ɪn ðə lɑt/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？那我也一併給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Toss them in? Like, for the same price?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɔs ðɛm ɪn laɪk fɚ ðə seɪm pɹaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 一併放進去？是說不用另外加錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, take the whole box too, why not.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ teɪk ðə hoʊl bɑks tu waɪ nɑt/
dialogue.zh: 當然，整箱你也帶走，何妨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, honestly? I'll pay a little extra.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ˈɑnəstli aɪl peɪ ə ˈlɪɾəl ˈɛkstrə/
dialogue.zh: 等下，說真的，我多補一點吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nah, end of day, it's all going anyway.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑ ɛnd əv deɪ ɪts ɔl ˈɡoʊɪŋ ˈɛniˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 不用啦，天快黑了，反正都要清掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're too good. Um, five more, okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ tu ɡʊd ʌm faɪv mɔɹ oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 你人太好了。嗯，再加五塊，可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep your money, just clear my driveway.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip jɔɹ ˈmʌni dʒʌst klɪɹ maɪ ˈdɹaɪvˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 錢留著吧，幫我把車道清空就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, deal. Can you help me carry it out?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ dil kən ju hɛlp mi ˈkæɹi ɪt aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 哈，成交。你能幫我搬到外面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: To your car? Sure, but my back says no.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu jɔɹ kɑɹ ʃʊɹ bʌt maɪ bæk sɛz noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 搬到你的車？好啊，但我的腰不答應。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No no, you steer, I'll do the lifting.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ noʊ ju stɪɹ aɪl du ðə ˈlɪftɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 不用，你指揮就好，我來搬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's a yes from me, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ə jɛs fɹʌm mi ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那就這樣說定了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which way should the table go, by the curb?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ weɪ ʃʊd ðə ˈteɪbəl ɡoʊ baɪ ðə kɝb/
dialogue.zh: 桌子要往哪邊放？路緣這邊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just past the bike, mind the garden hose.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst pæst ðə baɪk maɪnd ðə ˈɡɑɹdən hoʊz/
dialogue.zh: 腳踏車旁邊就好，小心那條水管。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it, hose, bike, no problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt hoʊz baɪk noʊ ˈpɹɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 知道了，水管、腳踏車，沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slowly now, don't scrape the floor legs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsloʊli naʊ doʊnt skɹeɪp ðə flɔɹ lɛɡz/
dialogue.zh: 慢一點，別刮到桌腳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's heavier than it looks, oh wow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈhɛviɚ ðæn ɪt lʊks oʊ waʊ/
dialogue.zh: 比看起來重多了，哇。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful on the step, almost there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɛɹfəl ɑn ðə stɛp ˈoʊlmoʊst ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 台階小心，就快到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Loaded! Thank you so much for this.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈloʊdɪd θæŋk ju soʊ mʌtʃ fɚ ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 放進車裡了！真是太謝謝你了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You cleared it all, thank you kindly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju klɪɹd ɪt ɔl θæŋk ju ˈkaɪndli/
dialogue.zh: 你把一切都搬走了，真謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you have more boxes out back?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju hæv mɔɹ ˈbɑksəz aʊt bæk/
dialogue.zh: 屋後還有別的箱子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nope, that was my last haul today.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊp ðʌt wʌz maɪ læst hɔ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 沒了，這是我今天清的最後一批。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then rest up. Here, keep the fifty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɹɛst ʌp hɪɹ kip ðə ˈfɪfti/
dialogue.zh: 那快去休息。這張五十你收著吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You want change? Oh, you're a dear.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju wɑnt tʃeɪndʒ oʊ jʊɹ ə dɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 你不要找零嗎？噢，你真體貼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's the least for the cookbooks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ðə list fɚ ðə ˈkʊkˌbʊks/
dialogue.zh: 光那些食譜就超值啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll wave at you from the porch, bye!
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl weɪv æt ju fɹʌm ðə pɔɹtʃ baɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我會站在門廊跟你揮手，再見！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bye, and good luck with the rest!
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ænd ɡʊd lʊk wɪð ðə ɹɛst/
dialogue.zh: 再見，祝你剩下的都能賣光！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, drive safe out there, okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks dɹaɪv seɪf aʊt ðɛɹ oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，路上開車小心，好嗎？

script.youtube_title: 【車庫特賣🚗】「你真會殺價」教你收攤前撿便宜＋整箱打包🎧📦🪑｜聽完就會客氣殺價｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Garage Sale Haggling
script.youtube_title_en: "You Drive a Hard Bargain" — Polite Haggling at a Garage Sale
script.youtube_description:
「你真會殺價」——社區車庫特賣進入最後一小時，怎麼客氣地把價格談下來，順便把一整箱好物打包帶走？這一集用 60 句連續真實對話，帶你從問價、殺價、換現金找零，一路聽到幫忙搬到車上與開心道別。

你會聽到：尾段特賣怎麼開口殺價；只有現金、沒帶零錢時怎麼辦；「整箱一起算」的 box lot 怎麼談；搬重物時怎麼客氣地說你指揮、我來搬；還有結尾想多算一點的那份人情。全程都是 A2 初級單字與美國人日常生活中真正會用的短句：um、well、so、ha、nah。聽完你就敢自己開口：Would you take...、Could we land near...、Do you take cash only。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，先聽兩遍，再大聲跟讀一遍，讓耳朵和嘴巴一起記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱並開啟小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"You drive a hard bargain" — the last hour of a neighborhood garage sale is the best time to ask for a lower price. This 60-line immersive listening practice walks you through a polite, friendly haggle from start to finish.

You will hear: opening a price talk at the end of the day, handling cash-only when you only have a big bill, asking to take a whole box lot of books for one price, and offering to do the lifting while the seller just directs. Everything stays in A2 words with the small talk Americans really use: um, well, so, ha, nah. By the end you'll own lines like Would you take..., Could we land near..., and Do you take cash only.

The last chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
社區車庫特賣快收攤了，你眼看一張心儀的小邊桌，卻怕開口殺價太失禮；身上又只有大鈔、沒帶零錢，該怎麼辦？

這一集帶你走進一場收尾的 garage sale，從問價、殺價、現金找零，一路聽到整箱打包、幫忙搬到車上與道別，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🪑 開口殺價：So, could we land somewhere near twenty-five?
💵 現金問題：Shoot, I only have a fifty on me.
📦 整箱打包：Sure, take the whole box too, why not.
🚚 幫忙搬運：No no, you steer, I'll do the lifting.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、so、nah 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，只要跟著這場特賣走一趟，下次看到心儀的小東西，你就會客氣地談個好價格。

祝你也能在收攤前，撿到屬於你的那張小邊桌。
script.thumbnail_action: handing over a folded five-dollar bill
